title: Public Relations in the world of AI
description: There is a moment every industry eventually reaches, when the tool that was supposed to set you apart becomes the thing everyone owns. For public relations, that moment has arrived quietly in the form of artificial intelligence that can write a press release in seconds. For John Caparros, media and community partnerships lead at PRecious Communications Philippines, the moment did not change what he believed. It confirmed it.
